summary: Today, we live in a world saturated with technology, computing, artificial intelligence, and websites overflowing with information that often lacks any real educational purpose. This is why our team, Nebulae of Dreams, was born—a mother-daughter collaboration driven by a desire to learn together and explore a shared interest: the work and history of NASA. Our project is a website designed to foster comprehensive learning for children, young people, and—why not?—adults with an interest in astronomy, specifically the work carried out by NASA. The site features stories about equipment left behind by NASA on Mars; the project is titled "MARS MUSEUM: The Secrets of Forgotten Objects"—an adventure that blends science, mystery, and imagination. Through a creative approach, the site presents information about each of these items, accompanied by a gallery of real images and a narrative featuring key figures related to our subject. Everything was created with the help of artificial intelligence tools and applications, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Canva, and Google Translate. Our primary goal is to continue developing the website by adding more NASA-related topics and providing regular updates.  indicar cuantas palabras tiene este texto
details: This project consists of a website created to share information about inactive equipment on Mars. It is designed primarily to engage children and teenagers, with the goal of sparking an interest in learning about Mars and the equipment used to study it. The site was built using Google Sites, incorporating tools such as Canva for design, advanced AI models like ChatGPT and Gemini for image generation, and Google Translate to verify the English translation. The project features a creative design with a child-friendly aesthetic, and the storytelling was crafted by a young girl.
